channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Weather forecast for The Players: Thursday rainout? JT says no
item.description: The PGA Tour’s official weather report for Thursday calls for a 70% of rain as a cold front is expected to move through, though Justin Thomas, a weather optimist, thinks it'll be fine.

item.title: Whoop: Bay Hill gets JT's, McIlroy's hearts pumping
item.description: Bay Hill was a beast at the Arnold Palmer Invitational. Whoop showed some increased heart rates this past week from the likes of Justin Thomas and Rory McIlroy.

item.title: Penske Performance: The numbers behind Bhatia's API title
item.description: Akshay Bhatia was brilliant on and around the greens in winning the 2026 Arnold Palmer Invitational. Penske looks inside the numbers in how he got it done.

item.title: Scheffler walks grounds, take practice shots at TPC Sawgrass
item.description: Scottie Scheffler made his Players Championship debut on Monday, taking practice shots on the range at TPC Sawgrass. Golf Channel is Live from The Players Championship to access how the world's top-ranked player has looked recently and what expectations are for him entering the year's "fifth major."

item.title: Full presser: Fleetwood talks apparel, Tiger ahead of The Players
item.description: Tommy Fleetwood speaks with media ahead of The Players Championship. Some of the subjects the world's third-ranked player touched on were his fashion to start the 2026 season, Tiger Woods' legacy and having family in the Middle East during recent current events.

item.title: Full presser: JT on form, clothes and 6 weather apps
item.description: Justin Thomas addressed the media Monday at The Players Championship, where he discussed his form, his clothing freedom and why he has so many weather apps.

item.title: Auburn, Jackson Koivun sweep Hayt titles after Charlotte counts late '10'
item.description: Just across A1A from the infamous 17th at TPC Sawgrass’ Stadium Course sits another penultimate hole that packed a punch on Monday.

item.title: Gary Woodland discusses PTSD struggles with Rex Hoggard
item.description: Gary Woodland sits down with Rex Hoggard to discuss his struggle with PTSD following brain surgery in September of 2023.

item.title: Players on The Players: Is March really ready for major?
item.description: Russell Henley, Xander Schauffele, and Jordan Spieth are just a few of the PGA Tour pros who have recently weighed in on the reputation of The Players Championship and if it belongs in consideration as golf's fifth major.

item.title: Will The Players ever gain major status?
item.description: Is there enough room for the Masters, PGA Championship, U.S. Open, Open and Championship to share at the top of the golf world? The Golf Central desk debates the merits of adding a fifth major to the schedule on Live from The Players.
